Branding

-

Settings

App-wide connections, keys and report branding. Crawl behavior - depth, rendering, URL rules, extraction - lives in Configuration profiles.

AI provider

Powers AI fix suggestions and the floating audit analyst. Bring your own key - any Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, GLM, Nara, custom…). Your key is stored on this computer and never shown here.

Report branding

White-label the exported Technical SEO Audit report with your own identity. Applied to every report you generate.

Integrations

Connect the services Scrawly enriches crawls with. Secrets live in .env and are never shown here.

WordPress connections

Each client connects its own WordPress site through the setup wizard, enabling guarded auto-fixes.
Looking for crawl settings? Depth, rendering, robots, URL include/exclude, extraction and duplicate rules live in reusable Configuration profiles.
